class: A: native tests of the pure garage files, and a headless Chrome run over the DevTools protocol with room/test/garage-shim.js. The shim proves API orchestration only: nothing here is a headset, haptic, hit-test, plane-detection or comfort result.
code_commit: the commit that carries this file, on branch todo/N8i

native.room cargo test: 91 passed (12 new in room/src/garage: launch 3, drive 5, planes 2, car 1, modes 1)

headless.flat_launch: 100 km/h first shown at 2.50 s and 2.52 s in two runs (pre-registered bound: one frame); 34.5 m at that moment against 34.7 m in the profile; speed only rises until 100; Esc restores the room
headless.vr_launch: immersive-vr requested inside the click; context made XR compatible; 1 clear and 3 viewports per frame; the trigger launched; pulses sent to both controllers, max intensity under 1; B ended the session and the room returned
headless.ar_life_size: immersive-ar requested inside the click with hit-test and plane-detection; clear alpha 0; the select placed the car at the hit result 0.50,-2.00
headless.ar_miniature: reversed into a detected vertical plane at z = -1.5 and stopped with its centre at z = -1.25 (the rear is 0.245 m behind the centre); haptic bumps sent to the right controller
headless.regressions: node room/test/headless.mjs and --platforms both pass on the same build

limitations: no headset was used: comfort, haptics, hit-test, planes, passthrough compositing and frame timing on a Meta Quest 3 are unknown until dhilipsiva reports
the flat-screen launch has no mouse look (keys only); the scene-view HUD has no garage button, only the conversation's Garage panel
the car is my own placeholder; no licensed model is loaded
